nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Single-stage Docker build for the Rolliúde Play backend, based on node:20-alpine, installing dependencies with Yarn and running the dev server on port 3000.
nodes.languageNotes: Single-stage build (no multi-stage separation of build and runtime); uses corepack to enable Yarn and runs `yarn dev`, which suggests this image targets local/dev usage rather than an optimized production build.

nodes.name: FROM node:20-alpine
nodes.summary: Base image stage pulling Node.js 20 on Alpine Linux as the runtime foundation for the backend container.

nodes.name: RUN corepack enable && yarn install --frozen-lockfile
nodes.summary: Enables Corepack and installs backend dependencies with a frozen Yarn lockfile to ensure reproducible builds.

nodes.name: CMD ["yarn", "dev"]
nodes.summary: Default container command that starts the backend in development mode via the `yarn dev` script.
